name: Dislocated Form (Psionic)
body:
Benefit(s): While maintaining psionic focus, you gain the compression universal monster ability, and take only half damage from being crushed. You may expend psionic focus to gain DR/- equal to your level against nonlethal damage until the start of your next turn.
